Wrote `docs/incidents/2026-09-10-renovate-requests-2.32-ci-failure.md`. Verified no Bifrost source imports `Mapping` from `collections` (only `defaultdict`/`deque`), confirming the failure came from the requests 2.32 dependency chain on our Python 3.11 runtime. Note covers summary, impact, timeline, root cause, detection gap, corrective actions, and lessons.

Key facts recorded: PR #4820 reverted to 2.31, CI green 2026-09-10 15:47 EDT, no production impact since the branch never merged. Follow-up pending is a verified re-attempt of the 2.32 upgrade (or a Renovate ignore rule if it keeps failing identically).
